handoff: AC1–AC8 met and tested at the fake runner; typecheck green, bun test 1266/1266; the review#1 fixes are in and tested. No blocking findings. Minor: the Herdr kill closes the pane AC3/B52 keeps (a person settles it); the --reset test asserts a counter that was already 0; hints derived from the receipt kind print 'norn unstick again' and 'norn stuck --help'; notHolder duplicates refuseUnlessHolder.

findings.title: Herdr kill closes the pane AC3/B52 says is kept
findings.detail:
AC3: '…the claim and the Herdr pane are all still there'. RunnerPort.kill on Herdr is `herdr pane close`. The slice Notes say 'use it as is', so the slice contradicts itself. The test checks commits, the uncommitted change, the branch and the claim, but not the pane.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: A person decides: change the spec, or give Herdr a stop-without-close later.

findings.title: --reset loop is asserted on a counter that was already 0
findings.detail:
counters: { loop: 0 } holds whether or not the reset happened. Only the journaled receipt proves --reset. human.test.ts has the same weakness.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Bump loop first (a gate reject), then assert it goes back to 0 after rerun --reset loop.

findings.title: Test title names a not-started case it never runs
findings.detail:
The title says 'a unit that is not started either', but no assertion covers it. That unit would refuse not_started, not nothing_to_cancel.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add the case or fix the title.

findings.title: Hints map receipt kind to verb, so they print removed or agent-only commands
findings.detail:
mailbox_failed prints `norn ${receipt.kind} again`, which reads 'norn unstick again' for run rerun. The usage hint at :196 does the same: 'norn unstick --help', and 'norn stuck --help' for run cancel (an agent verb). This is printed-hints territory (slice 14), but it is new code reaching a command this slice removed.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Pass the printing command (cmd.runRerun/runCancel) from the verb instead of deriving it from the kind.

findings.title: notHolder duplicates refuseUnlessHolder's wording
findings.detail:
The 'held by …' message is built again with a different do_instead (Duplicated Code). The holder check also runs twice, which implement#2 explained.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Let refuseUnlessHolder take a do_instead.

findings.title: (e as Error).message is an unchecked cast
findings.detail:
If the runner throws something that is not an Error, the message is undefined.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use String(e) when e is not an Error.

findings.title: resolveTarget imported as resolveUnit next to a different resolveTarget from target.ts
findings.detail:
Mysterious Name: two functions with the same name, one aliased. run-rerun.ts:11 does the same.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Rename one at its source.

findings.title: Narrow TOCTOU: the session is read before runHumanVerb re-checks the cursor
findings.detail:
If a tick relaunches between the two reads, the receipt is stale and the kill hits the old session. The window is small.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Take the session from the state runHumanVerb checked.

notes.text: AC3/B52 says the Herdr pane stays after run cancel, but RunnerPort.kill on Herdr runs 'herdr pane close' and the slice Notes say to use kill as is. Should the spec change, or does Herdr need a stop that keeps the pane?
